title: Xanthe and the Trail
author: Mirabel Eastwick
blurb: Kestrel Hartwell, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, has spent fifteen years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when an expedition upriver stops answering the radio, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
